:::{#def-leverage}
#### Leverage

Consider a linear model fitted by [ordinary least squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-ols),
with [covariate vectors](#def-covariate-vector) $\vecf{x}_1, \ldots, \vecf{x}_n$
and an invertible [cross-product matrix](#def-cross-product-matrix) $A$.
The **leverage** of observation $i$ is

$$
\lev{i} \eqdef \tp{\vxi} A^{-1} \vxi.
$$ {#eq-leverage}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@james2021islr2e [sec. 3.3.3],
written here with covariate vectors and the matrix $A$,
as in [the vector form of the OLS estimates](correlation-regression.qmd#thm-ols-slr-vector).
:::

:::
